name: app.bookare/bookare
title: Bookare
description: Online booking for gyms, salons, restaurants and stays. No commission, free plan. Set up by your AI.

tools.name: list_business_types
tools.description: The kinds of business Bookare can run, with how they work (classes, appointments, stays, tables) and the ready-made templates for each.

tools.name: check_address
tools.description: Checks whether name.bookare.app is free for a new venue. Takes a business name or a wanted address; returns the address, whether it is available, and free alternatives.

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: Bookare plans with their prices for a country (excluding VAT), limits and features, the free trial and the commission (none). The Free plan has no time limit; every new venue gets a free trial of Pro without a card.

country.description: Two-letter ISO code, e.g. GR. Default GR.

tools.name: create_venue
tools.description: Creates a draft venue for a business owner. Returns the booking page address, an access key for that venue, the venue’s own MCP address, and a claim link. The venue opens to customers only after the owner claims it with a code sent to their email; unclaimed drafts are deleted after 14 days.

business_type.description: Kind of business: gym, salon, restaurant, hotel, camping, rental or stay.

name.description: Business name as customers know it.

owner_email.description: The owner’s real email: they confirm the claim with a code sent there.

country.description: Two-letter ISO code, e.g. GR. Sets the prices of the plans.

language.description: Main language of the venue’s pages. Default el for GR and CY, else en.

address.description: Optional wanted address, the "name" in name.bookare.app. Default: made from the business name.

agent_name.description: Who is setting it up, e.g. "Claude for Acme Web Studio". Shown to the owner when claiming.

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: Name, type, contact details, booking rules, payment methods and today’s numbers for the connected venue. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Typical setups for this kind of venue (classes, timetable and packs; or services; or tables and hours; or units), each with its id and what it adds. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: setup_from_template
tools.description: Fills an empty or new venue with a typical setup in one call: e.g. "pilates" adds class types, a weekly timetable, packs with suggested prices and booking rules. replace_starter = true removes the empty starter class type made at sign-up. Returns what was added. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

template_id.description: Template id, e.g. pilates, yoga, hair_salon, restaurant, small_hotel, campsite.

tools.name: update_venue
tools.description: Changes the venue’s name, legal name, address, phones, contact email, website or opening hours: what customers see at the bottom of every page and in emails. Only the fields you send change; send an empty value to clear one. The venue type, country and booking address cannot be changed here. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

legal_name.description: The business’s legal name, shown on the privacy page as the data controller.

phones.description: Up to two phone numbers, the main one first. Numbers without a country code are taken as the venue’s country.

website.description: The venue’s own website, full address like https://example.gr. Used for the “back to site” button.

opening_hours.description: Opening hours, one line per group of days (up to 7 lines), e.g. ["Mon–Wed 09:00–13:00 & 16:00–21:00", "Sat 09:00–14:00"]. Empty list clears them.

tools.name: set_branding
tools.description: Sets the venue logo from a public https link to a PNG, JPG or WebP file (up to 300 KB), and/or its three colours as #rrggbb: hot (buttons, highlights), fresh (light accent), sun (yellow accent). Colours need the Plus or Pro plan (included in the trial). Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: get_embed_code
tools.description: Copy-paste code to show this venue’s timetable, packs, services, tables or stays on any website (WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, plain HTML), plus a "Book online" button and the booking page link. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: get_dns_instructions
tools.description: How the venue can use its own address (e.g. book.yourgym.com) for its booking pages. Available on the Pro plan; the owner switches it on in Settings → Link and domain after adding the DNS record. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: get_claim_link
tools.description: A new link for the owner to claim this draft venue (the previous link stops working). The owner opens it, confirms with a code sent to their email and accepts the terms; then the booking pages open to customers. Until then the venue takes no members or bookings and sends no emails, and it is deleted automatically on its expiry date. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: list_class_types
tools.description: The kinds of class the venue runs (e.g. Pilates Reformer, Fitness), with default spots. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: create_class_type
tools.description: Adds a kind of class (e.g. "Yoga Flow") for the weekly timetable. Returns the new class type with its id. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

colour.description: fresh = light green, hot = red, sun = yellow, ink = dark, chip = grey.

booked_with_packs.description: Default true. False = only the venue books it, no pack is charged.

drop_in.description: True = no times on the timetable: people just come in and check in (e.g. the gym floor). Each check-in takes one class from their pack, at most once a day.

tools.name: update_class_type
tools.description: Renames a class type or changes its default spots, colour, whether packs are charged or whether it is drop-in. Spots apply to classes created from now on. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

drop_in.description: True = no times on the timetable: people just come in and check in (e.g. the gym floor). Each check-in takes one class from their pack, at most once a day.

tools.name: delete_class_type
tools.description: Deletes a class type that has never been on the timetable. One that has classes or history cannot be deleted; rename it instead. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: list_instructors
tools.description: Instructors that can be put on a class. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: add_instructor
tools.description: Adds a name to the instructors that can be put on a class. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: get_timetable
tools.description: The repeating weekly timetable: one row per weekly class. Classes on the calendar are generated from these. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: add_weekly_class
tools.description: Adds a repeating class to the weekly timetable. Classes for the coming days appear on the calendar at once. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

time.description: Start time in the venue’s local time, HH:MM (24h).

spots.description: Optional. Defaults to the class type’s spots (1-50).

off_peak.description: Optional. Marks the class as off-peak.

tools.name: update_weekly_class
tools.description: Moves a weekly class to another day or time, or changes its type, instructor, spots, duration or off-peak mark. Only the fields you send change. Dates that already have bookings stay at the old time. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

weekly_class_id.description: Id of the weekly class on the timetable.

time.description: Start time in the venue’s local time, HH:MM (24h).

spots.description: Optional. Defaults to the class type’s spots (1-50).

off_peak.description: Optional. Marks the class as off-peak.

tools.name: remove_weekly_class
tools.description: Takes a class off the weekly timetable. Future dates without bookings disappear; dates that already have bookings stay. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: set_booking_rules
tools.description: Sets how many hours before a class a member can cancel free, how many classes can be booked on an unpaid pack, how many days ahead members can book, and whether people still booked when a class ends count as attended automatically (otherwise the team marks each one). Only the fields you send change. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

attended_automatically_after_class.description: True (default): when a class ends, everyone not marked as no-show counts as attended. False: the team marks attendance; unmarked people stay booked.

tools.name: list_packs
tools.description: The packs the venue sells (including hidden ones), in the order members see them. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: create_pack
tools.description: Adds a new pack to what the venue sells. It is visible to members straight away. Returns the new pack. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

classes.description: How many classes the pack holds (1-200). Leave out when unlimited is true.

unlimited.description: True for unlimited classes until it expires.

valid_days.description: Days the pack is valid from the day it is bought (1-730).

tagline.description: One short line under the name.

description.description: Longer description shown with the pack.

class_type_ids.description: Class types the pack can be used for. Empty list = all.

off_peak_only.description: True if it can be used only for classes marked off-peak.

on_sale_until.description: YYYY-MM-DD: a limited-time pack members can buy until the end of that day. Empty string = always on sale.

public_page.description: True (default): visitors who are not signed in see the pack on the venue page. False: only signed-in members see it.

price_on_public_page.description: True (default): visitors who are not signed in see the price. False: they see "Price for members"; signed-in members see the price.

tools.name: update_pack
tools.description: Changes a pack on sale. Only the fields you send change. Packs members have already bought keep their own terms and are not affected. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

classes.description: How many classes the pack holds (1-200). Leave out when unlimited is true.

unlimited.description: True for unlimited classes until it expires.

valid_days.description: Days the pack is valid from the day it is bought (1-730).

tagline.description: One short line under the name.

description.description: Longer description shown with the pack.

class_type_ids.description: Class types the pack can be used for. Empty list = all.

off_peak_only.description: True if it can be used only for classes marked off-peak.

on_sale_until.description: YYYY-MM-DD: a limited-time pack members can buy until the end of that day. Empty string = always on sale.

public_page.description: True (default): visitors who are not signed in see the pack on the venue page. False: only signed-in members see it.

price_on_public_page.description: True (default): visitors who are not signed in see the price. False: they see "Price for members"; signed-in members see the price.

tools.name: set_pack_visibility
tools.description: visible = false deactivates a pack: it is hidden and can no longer be bought; members who have it keep it. visible = true activates it again. This is the safe way to stop selling a pack. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: delete_pack
tools.description: Permanently removes a pack from what the venue sells. Packs members already bought are kept. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: list_coupons
tools.description: Coupons for buying packs: automatic ones and ones with a code, with who and which packs they are for, dates and how often they were used. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: create_coupon
tools.description: Creates a coupon for buying packs. kind: percent (value = % off), amount (value_eur off), extra (value = free classes added), bonus (value = % more classes, same price and expiry: 30 turns 10 classes into 13; 100 = 1+1, double). Free classes do not apply to unlimited packs. Without code it applies automatically to the members it is for; with code the member types it when buying. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

name.description: Shown to members next to the price, e.g. "New Year".

value.description: percent: 1-100; extra: 1-100 classes; bonus: 1-500 (% more classes, 100 = 1+1). Not for amount.

code.description: Optional code, 3-30 Latin letters, digits or dashes. Leave out for an automatic coupon.

member_ids.description: Only for these members (with group_ids). Leave both out for all members.

pack_ids.description: Only for these packs (pack ids). Leave out for all packs.

max_uses.description: Total uses. Leave out for no limit.

per_member.description: Uses per member, 0 = no limit. Default 1.

tools.name: set_coupon_active
tools.description: Pauses a coupon (it stops applying) or resumes it. Packs already bought with it are not affected. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: get_agenda_setup
tools.description: What the venue offers by appointment (services with duration and price, staff) or, for restaurants, its tables; and the opening hours. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: set_opening_hours
tools.description: Replaces the hours when appointments or tables can be booked. One row per period, several per day allowed (e.g. 10:00-14:00 and 17:00-21:00). Days not listed are closed. For restaurants "to" is the last time a table can be booked. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: add_service
tools.description: Adds a service customers can book by appointment, e.g. "Women’s haircut", 45 minutes, €25. It is done by the staff listed (default: all staff). Not for restaurants. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: add_staff
tools.description: Adds a person customers can book with. They do all services unless service_ids is given. Not for restaurants. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: add_table
tools.description: Restaurants and bars: adds a table (or several identical ones) with its seats. Online bookings get the smallest free table that fits the party. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

name.description: e.g. "Table" or "Terrace". Numbered automatically when count > 1.

from_party_of.description: Smallest party it is given to online, default 1.

tools.name: list_stay_options
tools.description: The fixed lists used by the other tools: unit kinds, bed kinds, amenity keys for units and for the venue (with their English and Greek labels). Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: list_units
tools.description: Everything the venue rents by the night (rooms, homes, caravans, pitches) with price, capacity, beds, amenities and photos. Includes hidden units. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: create_unit
tools.description: Adds something the venue rents by the night: a room, apartment, home, caravan, glamping tent or pitch. For several identical ones (e.g. 20 pitches) create one unit and set identical_units. Guests can see and book it straight away unless shown_to_guests or takes_bookings is false. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

name.description: Name guests see, e.g. "Sea-view studio" or "Tent or camper pitch".

price_per_night_eur.description: Base price per night in euro (seasons can override it).

identical_units.description: How many identical ones exist, e.g. 20 tent and camper pitches. Default 1.

description.description: Free text for guests (up to 600 characters).

size_sqm.description: Size in square metres. 0 = not shown.

beds.description: How many beds of each kind, e.g. {"double":1,"single":2}. Kinds: double, single, sofa, bunk.

amenities.description: Unit amenity keys (the unit_amenities list of this venue’s stay options), e.g. ["wifi","ac","kitchen"].

shown_to_guests.description: False hides the unit from the booking page. Default true.

takes_bookings.description: False keeps the unit visible to guests but they cannot book it (e.g. not ready yet); its nights are closed on connected channels too. The venue can still add bookings itself. Default true.

tools.name: update_unit
tools.description: Changes a unit. Only the fields you send change. Existing bookings keep their agreed total. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

name.description: Name guests see, e.g. "Sea-view studio" or "Tent or camper pitch".

price_per_night_eur.description: Base price per night in euro (seasons can override it).

identical_units.description: How many identical ones exist, e.g. 20 tent and camper pitches. Default 1.

description.description: Free text for guests (up to 600 characters).

size_sqm.description: Size in square metres. 0 = not shown.

beds.description: How many beds of each kind, e.g. {"double":1,"single":2}. Kinds: double, single, sofa, bunk.

amenities.description: Unit amenity keys (the unit_amenities list of this venue’s stay options), e.g. ["wifi","ac","kitchen"].

shown_to_guests.description: False hides the unit from the booking page. Default true.

takes_bookings.description: False keeps the unit visible to guests but they cannot book it (e.g. not ready yet); its nights are closed on connected channels too. The venue can still add bookings itself. Default true.

tools.name: delete_unit
tools.description: Deletes a unit together with its photos. A unit that has ever had a booking is not deleted: it is hidden from guests instead, so the booking history stays. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: What a guest sees at the top of the booking page: the description of the place, its amenities and its photos. Also the booking rules and the seasonal prices. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: set_listing
tools.description: Sets the description of the place shown at the top of the booking page, and the venue-wide amenities. Only the fields sent are changed. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

amenities.description: Venue amenity keys (the venue_amenities list of this venue’s stay options). Replaces the current list.

tools.name: add_photo
tools.description: Adds a photo to a unit, or to the venue itself when unit_id is left out. Give the direct public https link to an existing photo file (jpg, png or webp, up to 15 MB): it is downloaded, resized and stored. The first photo of a group is its cover. Up to 16 per unit and for the venue. It stores existing photos only; it does not create images. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

image_url.description: Direct link to the photo file.

unit_id.description: Leave out for a photo of the venue as a whole.

tools.name: remove_photo
tools.description: Deletes one photo (of a unit or of the venue) for good. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: set_cover_photo
tools.description: Puts a photo first in its group (the unit or the venue), so it is the one guests see in lists. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: add_season
tools.description: A date range with a different price per night (high season, Easter…), for one unit or for all. Nights inside it use this price instead of the unit’s base price. A season for a specific unit wins over one for all units; a night’s own price wins over both. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

unit_id.description: Leave out to apply to all units.

min_nights.description: Optional minimum stay for bookings that start in this season (2-60).

tools.name: remove_season
tools.description: Deletes a seasonal price. Nights in it go back to the base price. Existing bookings keep their agreed total. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: list_nightly_prices
tools.description: Every night that has its own price, joined into ranges with the same price. For one unit or all. Defaults to today and the next 365 days. Seasonal prices are not included. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: set_nightly_price
tools.description: Gives its own price per night to one night or a range (e.g. Christmas), for one unit or (without unit_id) for every unit. It wins over seasons and the base price. weekdays limits it to some days of the week, e.g. ["fri","sat"] for weekends in July. Existing bookings keep their agreed total. For one night, send only from. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

unit_id.description: Leave out to set it on every unit.

to.description: Last night (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Default: same as from.

weekdays.description: Optional: only these nights of the week.

tools.name: reset_nightly_price
tools.description: Removes the own price of nights in a range, so they go back to the season or base price. For one unit or (without unit_id) every unit. For one night, send only from. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Default: same as from.

tools.name: list_closed_days
tools.description: Days the venue has closed itself (holiday, own use, an event), for one unit or for all units. Nobody can book those nights, online, by the venue or on connected channels. Defaults to everything from today on. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: close_days
tools.description: Makes one day or a whole range unavailable, for one unit or (without unit_id) for all units: no bookings can be made on those nights, online, by the venue or on connected channels. A closed day means nobody can stay that night. Existing bookings on those days are not cancelled; they are listed in the answer. For one day, send only from. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

to.description: Last closed night (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Default: same as from.

unit_id.description: Leave out to close all units.

reason.description: Optional, only the venue sees it, e.g. "Holiday" or "Family visit".

tools.name: open_days
tools.description: Opens closed days again for bookings. With unit_id it opens only what was closed for that unit (days closed for all units stay closed); without unit_id it opens every closed day in the range. Part of a longer closed range can be opened; the rest stays closed. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

to.description: Last night to open (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Default: same as from.

unit_id.description: Leave out to open the range for all units.

tools.name: set_stay_rules
tools.description: Check-in and check-out times, whether online bookings are confirmed at once or wait for the venue, and until how many days before arrival a guest may cancel. Only the fields sent are changed. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

instant_confirmation.description: False = each online booking waits for the venue to confirm.

tools.name: import_status
tools.description: For moving a venue from another system. Shows how many members, packs, bookings and check-ins were imported (and how many exist in total). Imports never email anyone, and re-running with the same external_id values does not create duplicates. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

tools.name: import_members
tools.description: Moving from another system: adds up to 100 existing or former members at once, with their join date and status. No email is sent. A row whose external_id was imported before, or whose email already exists here, is reported as existing and left unchanged. Needs email, phone or external_id per row. Members who joined in the last 90 days count towards the plan’s member limit. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

external_id.description: The member’s id in the old system. Strongly recommended: re-running skips them, and packs and bookings can point to it.

joined.description: When they joined, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

status.description: Default active. disabled = former member who can no longer sign in.

wants_news.description: True only if they agreed in the old system to receive offers and news.

groups.description: Group names (e.g. "Morning team"). Missing groups are created. Also added to members that already exist.

tools.name: import_member_packs
tools.description: Moving from another system: adds up to 100 member packs at once, current or past, with their start and expiry dates, classes already used, price and whether (and when) they were paid. No email is sent and no receipt is asked for. Each row refers to a member already imported. Bookings imported later do not take classes again: classes_used is what counts. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

external_id.description: The pack’s id in the old system.

member_external_id.description: The external_id the member was imported with.

pack_id.description: Optional. Id of a pack on sale to copy name, classes, price and class types from; any field sent wins.

classes.description: Classes the pack held in total (1-1000). Leave out when unlimited.

classes_used.description: Classes already used in the old system, including classes already booked for the future. Default 0.

starts.description: Start / purchase date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

expires.description: Last day it can be used, YYYY-MM-DD. Default starts + the pack’s valid days (needs pack_id).

paid.description: True if it was paid. Default false.

method.description: How it was (or will be) paid. Default cash.

class_type_ids.description: Class types it can be used for. Empty or missing = all (or as pack_id).

tools.name: import_bookings
tools.description: Moving from another system: adds up to 100 bookings at once, past (with attendance) or upcoming. Each row names the class by class_id, or by date, time and class_type_id; a past class that is not on the calendar is created. An upcoming class must already be on the calendar. Nothing is emailed and no pack is charged again (classes_used on the imported pack already counts them); the booking is linked to the member’s pack so a later cancellation gives the class back. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

external_id.description: The booking’s id in the old system.

guest_name.description: For a person without an account. Leave out the member fields.

class_id.description: Id of a class on the calendar. Or give date, time and class_type_id instead.

time.description: Start time HH:MM, venue local time.

instructor_id.description: Only used when a past class has to be created.

duration_minutes.description: Only used when a class has to be created. Default 60.

status.description: Default: attended for past classes, booked for future ones. Future classes take only booked or cancelled.

member_pack_id.description: The member pack it was booked with.

pack_external_id.description: Or the external_id the member’s pack was imported with. Without either, the member’s pack that covered that day is linked.

free.description: True = not booked with a pack (gift, free class).

tools.name: import_visits
tools.description: Moving from another system: adds up to 100 past check-ins at once for drop-in class types (no times on the timetable, people just come in), one per member, class type and day. No pack is charged again; the visit is linked to the given pack, or the member’s pack that covered that day. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

class_type_id.description: A drop-in class type (no times on the timetable, people just check in).
